---
title: "Custom key in a locale-variation language file reaches templates (#14772)"
lang: fr
language: some-language.yml
format:
  typst:
    template-partials:
      - typst-show.typ
    keep-typ: true
_quarto:
  tests:
    typst:
      ensureTypstFileRegexMatches:
        -
          - 'custom key: `Valeur personnalisee`'
        -
          - 'custom key: ``'
      noErrors: true
---

Regression test for #14772. `readLanguageTranslations` reads the base
`language:` file and any sibling `_<file>-<lang>.yml` locale-variation
files, but its per-key gate only accepted keys already known to Quarto
(`kLanguageDefaultsKeys`) or object values (nested locale sub-blocks). A
custom scalar key shipped in the locale-variation file — the extension
author's motivating use case for PR #14773 — was silently dropped before
it ever reached `translationsForLang`.

`some-language.yml` is the base file (empty; no built-in overrides).
`some-language-fr.yml` is the French variation and carries `custom-key`.

The end.
